profile.headline: Software Engineer at SYSO Technologies
profile.summary: As Glennon Doyle says, "We can do hard things," and this motto inspires the work I do every day as an advocate for and professional in clean technology. I'm inspired to create a healthy and equitable clean energy future for all, centering environmental justice in the transition to a "green" society. I'm driven to learn more from and be a part of organizations that empower and believe in the same mission and will use my own unique background in data analysis and mathematical modeling combined with my enthusiasm for and experience in GIS to contribute to this mission. Although the fight for an equitable and healthy energy future may be hard, it's most definitely worth it.

positions.title: Operations Engineer
positions.description:
-Lead the operations team in management and troubleshooting of technical systems and tools and data integrations
-Manage software and hardware needed for live telemetry with ISO and LCCs across the US
-Utilize SQL coding skills to write and improve alerting for operational sites and systems
-Build and maintain operation procedure and runbook repository

positions.title: Smart Grids Innovation Intern
positions.description:
As a Smart Grids Innovation intern, I worked on multiple data analysis projects and other initiatives focusing on electric vehicle charging and electric heating usage patterns. These included:
-Developed and implemented new forecasting strategies at an OPCO and circuit level for Avangrid’s internal electric vehicle adoption and charging load forecasting 
-Analyzed metering data for customers owning electric vehicles and heat pumps to build charging and usage load shapes for these technologies using Excel
-Wrote a literature review to organize and summarize all necessary data and reports needed to support team’s modeling and forecasting assumptions and strategies

positions.title: Climate Intern
positions.description:
As a Climate Intern, I worked on many projects and initiatives relating to clean technology that would factor into the County's Climate Action Plan, including:
-Created a database using Excel for solar installations in the County and subsequently analyzed solar installation trends in the County to inform future strategies in facilitating increased installations. 
-Worked with a team to start the planning process for an Electric Vehicle Group Buy program in the County by researching best practices and writing and issuing an RFI. 
-Helped to start initial planning for a technical assistance program for energy efficiency and renewable energy upgrades in the County by conducting research on successful programs and regional resources and helping to draft a budget proposal. 
-Analyzed greenhouse gas emission trends in the County and wrote an article for the County’s blog and newsletter to inform constituents about the causes of these trends.

positions.title: Remote Intern
positions.description: Organized lithium battery storage system proposals and performed research on energy source availability in different regions in order to determine best places for renewable energy and energy storage investment.

positions.title: STEM Camp Counselor
positions.description: Helped to lead the Bakken STEM summer camps for students in grades second to ninth. Aided students in developing engineering skills and designing and creating their own projects using these skills.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Instruct students from early elementary to high school in mathematics.

positions.title: Research Volunteer
positions.description: Entered papers and journals into database.

company.name: University of Minnesota Neuromodulation Research Center

volunteerExperiences.description: Helped deliver medicine, core specimen, and blood; discharged patients; and ran general errands.
